title: Pin Bun back to 1.3.14 per DEC-163 (8), with the LCLI-648 floor test skipped on 1.3.14 and the epoll retry guard corrected
description:
DEC-163 (8) ruling (opum-doc), relayed by opum-agent 2026-10-06: pin Bun BACK to 1.3.14, because the two-window LCLI-660 measurement shows the Linux epoll race fires on the pinned 1.4.2 (10/20 window 1, 17/20 window 2) and never on 1.3.14 (0/20 both windows).

LCLI-648 (the contextual-keyword parser panic that motivated the move TO 1.4.2) is worked around by AVOIDING THE CONSTRUCT: lore's source uses neither Bun.Transpiler nor a top-level `declare` binding (verified -- the only occurrences are inside the LCLI-648 floor test itself), so the bug cannot bite shipped code. The floor test deliberately exercises the panicking repro, so it must SKIP on 1.3.14 and name LCLI-648 in the skip.

Correct ci.yml's epoll retry-guard comment, which still says both behind-guard observations were taken on the 1.3.14 floor and that LCLI-648 moved the pin without re-measuring -- the re-measurement now exists and points the other way.

Pin forward again only once the SAME two-window measurement confirms a Bun epoll fix. No pin change was made by this repository before this ruling; this task implements it, on the operator's authority through opum-doc.

acceptanceCriteria.text: .bun-version and every live pin site read 1.3.14: package.json (engines.bun, @types/bun, packageManager), .github/actions/strict-check/action.yml, and .github/workflows/release.yml's Ladybug qualification check; bun.lock is regenerated if it carries the runtime; every remaining literal of 1.4.2 is classified as a live site, a historical record, or a deliberate differential before it is left alone, and the count is reported from a grep rather than remembered.
The LCLI-648 floor test skips on 1.3.14 and NAMES LCLI-648 in the skip, and lore's source is confirmed (by grep) to use neither Bun.Transpiler nor a top-level `declare` binding.
ci.yml's epoll retry-guard comment is corrected to record the two-window result (1.4.2 races, 1.3.14 does not) and that the retry stays until the same measurement confirms a Bun epoll fix.

bun test, `bun run lore check`, typecheck and lint pass on the head, with any workstation-only failure named and its reachability stated; the change touches release.yml, so a reviewer pass runs before it lands.
Lands on dev by squash merge with every required check a completed success on the exact head SHA.

plan: Grep the pin sites; classify every 1.4.2 literal as live / historical / deliberate differential.
Set .bun-version and the live pin sites to 1.3.14; regenerate bun.lock and any generated README version lines.
Gate the LCLI-648 floor test to skip on 1.3.14, naming LCLI-648; confirm by grep that lore source avoids the construct.
Correct ci.yml epoll retry-guard comment and the LCLI-648 differential comment.
Validate: bun test, bun run lore check, typecheck, lint; reviewer pass (release.yml is touched).
Land by squash with required checks green on the head.
